roomRent.label: Up to ₹5,000 per day for a normal room (1% of sum insured); ICU up to 2%

citation.quote: Room, boarding and nursing expenses are payable up to 1% of the Sum Insured per day for a normal room and up to 2% of the Sum Insured per day for ICU.

coPay.label: 10% co-pay for members aged 61 or above (applies to Mohan)

citation.quote: For Insured Persons aged 61 years or above at the time of admission, a co-payment of 10% shall apply on every admissible claim.
Expenses for cataract treatment are payable up to ₹40,000 per eye per policy year.
Road ambulance charges are payable up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation.

waitingPeriods.label: Initial waiting period
waitingPeriods.appliesTo: All illnesses (accidents are covered from day 1)

citation.quote: Expenses for any illness contracted within 30 days from the first policy commencement date are excluded, except claims arising due to an accident.
The listed conditions in Annexure I, including cataract, hernia and joint replacement, are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage.

waitingPeriods.label: Pre-existing diseases (declared: diabetes – Mohan)
waitingPeriods.appliesTo: Conditions declared in the proposal form

citation.quote: Expenses related to pre-existing diseases are covered after 36 months of continuous coverage from the first policy commencement date.

traps.title: A room above ₹5,000 a day costs you more than the room
traps.explanation: If your room costs more than the limit, the insurer also cuts doctor and nursing charges by the same share.

citation.quote: Where the room category exceeds eligibility, all associated medical expenses shall be payable in the same proportion as the eligible room rent bears to the actual room rent.

traps.title: You pay 10% of your father's bills
traps.explanation: Mohan is over 61. For his claims, you pay 10% of the bill yourself (this is called co-pay).

citation.quote: For Insured Persons aged 61 years or above at the time of admission, a co-payment of 10% shall apply on every admissible claim.

traps.title: Gloves, PPE kits and admission kits are never paid
traps.explanation: The insurer never pays for these items unless you bought extra cover for them. You didn't.

citation.quote: List I – Items for which coverage is not available: gloves, PPE kit, admission kit, ...

traps.title: Cataract: at most ₹40,000 per eye
traps.explanation: Even after the waiting time, the insurer pays no more than ₹40,000 per eye.

citation.quote: Expenses for cataract treatment are payable up to ₹40,000 per eye per policy year.

traps.title: Tell the insurer within 48 hours of an emergency stay
traps.explanation: If you tell them late, they may question the claim. Keep proof of when you told them.

citation.quote: In case of emergency hospitalisation, the Company/TPA must be informed within 48 hours of admission.

flags.message: One rule (Clause 5.3) mentions "associated medical expenses" but doesn't list them. Ask the insurer which charges it means.

citation.quote: Where the room category exceeds eligibility, all associated medical expenses shall be payable in the same proportion as the eligible room rent bears to the actual room rent.

flags.message: Page 15 mentions a list of day-care treatments (Annexure III), but that list is not in your file. Ask the insurer for it.
